era_guard: manifest contract_version and method_version of each returns partition used; one pair or refuse
windows_before_floor: NOT_SPANNED in words; no number is served
words: The guard reads the manifest.json of every returns partition at or after the floor 2026-07-10 that the floor-limited listing keeps, through the adapter guard and the handler's own reader, before any returns data is read. Each manifest must carry both contract_version and method_version; the distinct pairs across the used partitions must be exactly one, else the day refuses with a SystemExit whose message names the contract: a manifest naming neither field or not both, an absent manifest, or two pairs. A refused day is printed as FILLED_SKIPPED and returned as failed, and nothing is written. A built day states returns_from, the earliest returns partition it used, and contract, the one pair it used. The Commonwealth partition of 2026-06-22 is never listed, opened or named by a build of a later day. Not proven here: the Lambda runtime, the first real build of any day, and a literal 'returns from July 10, 2026' text row in the served report, which would change the report contract and is not made in this cell.
